text: M13 `lbqrd6xh`: 'Reset to default order — usuwa klucz', saved with the card's shared [Save] (PATCH /config). The DTO `patch-config-request` types `elementsMenu` as the entry array only (no null) and the PATCH contract has no other way to delete a key from config.json. Assumed: PATCH accepts `elementsMenu: null`, which removes the key from the file (no type check, no save rule); the response then omits the field. Implemented as a generic field-registry flag `nullRemovesKey` (set only on `elementsMenu`) and `writeConfig(cwd, partial, remove)`. Proposed spec change: patch-config-request field `elementsMenu` type `(...)[] | null`, description 'null removes the key (Reset to default order)'.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-0001 — the DTO `patch-config-request` types the field as an array only; `null` is how the card's [Save] removes the key.
